title: Build a counter
summary: Each click will run an event callback. Put the count variable outside the callback, and the callback can accumulate the previous value each time.
tasks: Initialize the counter variable to 0 in your script.
Each time #add is clicked, the count is incremented by 1, and the new value is written to #count.
hint: Write let count = 0 outside the event callback, and use count += 1 in the callback.
goal: Saves the cumulative number of times between multiple clicks and displays the latest number on the page.

example.note: Every time a participant is registered at the check-in desk, the count is increased, and the page displays the current number of people who have arrived.
